subject: Evaluation handover + stakeholder matrix & exec decision call
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Park <alice@nexahealth.com>, Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + draft success criteria for NexaHealth trial

Hi Alice & Tom —

Thanks again for the call today. High-level recap and proposed next steps below so we stay aligned before the trial kickoff. I copied Connor (solutions) and Jordan (sales lead) so owners are clear.

Call highlights:
- Goals: validate Redwood's hosting with your PHI-safe pipeline and measure accuracy lift on triage classification model.
- Timeline you requested: 3-week technical trial, then exec readout for go/no-go.
- Risk areas: indexing latency for long documents, model degradation on edge cases, procurement review still pending.

Draft success criteria (attached as a spreadsheet — "nexa_trial_success_criteria.xlsx"):
1) Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end < 350ms for 1–2k token requests under a steady-state throughput of 10 rps.
2) Accuracy: micro-F1 >= 0.88 on your holdout set (we'll run our eval harness).
3) Stability: no more than 1 unplanned restart per 72hr window during the trial.
4) Data handling: all logs must be written to your S3 bucket with lifecycle 90d and not retained in Redwood logs beyond agreed window.

Proposed ownership:
- Trial config, infra & KV caching: Connor O'Brien (redwood).
- Eval harness and metrics: Kimberly Park (redwood) + Nexa data lead (Alice).
- Procurement and commercial: Jordan Blake (redwood) + Nexa procurement email (procurement@nexahealth.com).

Next steps (please confirm):
1) Nexa to confirm success criteria or flag changes by Mon 23 Nov.
2) Redwood to publish trial runbook and shared Drive folder (I attached the initial stakeholder matrix).
3) We hold the exec readout window Tues 24 Nov 09:00–10:00 PT for go/no-go — please confirm who will attend.

Attachments: nexa_trial_success_criteria.xlsx, nexa_stakeholder_matrix.csv

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Park <alice@nexahealth.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + draft success criteria for NexaHealth trial

Adding a quick implementation note for the runbook:

- We'll provision a dedicated pool (2x A10G equiv) with autoscale to 4 for burst.
- Default batching and prefix KV cache enabled; we'll apply an explicit cache TTL of 30s for the trial to mimic production behavior.
- Instrumentation: we'll stream traces to the Nexa S3 bucket and send aggregate telemetry to your ops email during the run.

Owners clarified: I'll manage the infra deploy and nightly health checks. Kimberly, can you confirm which 3 sample queries Nexa wants as part of the smoke tests? I put a placeholder in the Drive.

Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Alice Park <alice@nexahealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@nexahealth.com>, procurement@nexahealth.com
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + draft success criteria for NexaHealth trial

Thanks Kimberly — this is helpful. A few quick edits from our side:

- Accuracy target: we can accept micro-F1 >= 0.86 for the initial 3-week run if we have a plan to improve to 0.88 within the first month post-trial. Can you add a short remediation plan to the runbook?
- Latency: 350ms 95th is OK provided you include telemetry breakdowns (model vs. IO).
- Data handling: procurement needs a short paragraph that confirms no PHI will be persisted in Redwood logs and that S3 is the single source of truth for audit extracts.

We confirm the exec readout window on Tue 24 Nov 09:00 PT; Tom will attend plus one engineering manager. Procurement will follow up with contract questions — pointer to procurement@nexahealth.com.

I'll upload 3 sample queries to the shared Drive by EOD Mon.

Best,
Alice Park
Director of Data Science, NexaHealth

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Alice Park <alice@nexahealth.com>
Cc: procurement@nexahealth.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + draft success criteria for NexaHealth trial

Follow-up on procurement cadence and exec slate:

Procurement asks:
- Can we deliver a redlined SOW by Wed 25 Nov? I attached a draft SOW (nexa_sow_draft.pdf) — procurement, please flag anything blocking.
- On pricing: Jordan proposed commercial tiers and a short-term trial credit; Kimberly, can you confirm the trial credit and any procurement approvals needed for a paid pilot?

Exec decision call agenda (15–25 min):
1) Trial results summary (Kimberly & Connor)
2) Success criteria pass/fail and evidence (Alice & Redwood)
3) Commercial ask and next steps (Jordan)
4) Q&A and go/no-go decision (Tom)

Kimberly — I'll draft the commercial summary and include the proposed pilot credit.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@nexahealth.com>, Alice Park <alice@nexahealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Final calendar invite + pre-read for exec decision (NexaHealth trial)

Tom / Alice — thanks for confirming the slot. Attached is the pre-read folder in Drive with:
- final_runbook.md (notes + remediation plan)
- nexa_trial_success_criteria.xlsx (updated with your accuracy guardrail and remediation timeline)
- nexa_stakeholder_matrix.csv (roles & primary contacts)
- nexa_sow_draft.pdf (Jordan's commercial summary included)

Quick call logistics: Tue 24 Nov 09:00–09:30 PT (join link below). Please confirm attendees; if anything else is needed before the readout, reply here.

Join: https://meet.google.com/redwood-nexa-exec
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/8421

Decision criteria (explicit):
- Pass = at least 3/4 success criteria met AND documented remediation plan for any shortfall accepted by Nexa.
- Fail = >1 major criteria unmet with no acceptable remediation timeline.

Thanks all — looking forward to the readout.

Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: final_runbook.md, nexa_trial_success_criteria.xlsx, nexa_stakeholder_matrix.csv, nexa_sow_draft.pdf
